newsitem.title: USA: Dow industrials dip, Nasdaq up.
newsitem.headline: Dow industrials dip, Nasdaq up.

text.p: The Dow industrials sagged into negative territory Wednesday after an opening rise.
They are weighed down by concerns about further Federal Reserve rate increases following a strong report on February durable goods.
The Dow was off 1.13 to 6873.90. The Nasdaq rose 6.80 to 1254.86, boosted by bargain-hunting.
The U.S. Treasury 30-year bond was off 8/32 to yield 6.99 percent. The S&P 500 futures index was up 0.32 to 789.39.
